steps.instruction: On the ticket detail page for {{02-create.ticket_reference}}, the app refuses to mark the ticket Ready because both parts have no supplier. Satisfy that precondition: edit the part '{{runid}} RD Part A' and set its Supplier field (if it's a dropdown/select pick any available supplier option; if free text type 'Acme Parts'), keeping cost 150 and markup 25 unchanged, and save. Then edit the part '{{runid}} RD Part B' the same way and set its Supplier (same supplier as Part A), keeping cost 200 and markup 25, and save. Wait for the parts table to refresh after each save and confirm both parts now show a supplier. Then click '{{06-change.mark_ready_button}}' and report: the exact supplier value each part now shows, each part's cost/markup/price after the edits, whether {{06-change.mark_ready_button}} succeeded, the ticket's {{06-change.status_field_label}} as displayed afterwards, and any confirmation or error message shown.
